executive_summary: CKA seq 10 advances three threads: (1) TPUSA financial concerns raised by Charlie Kirk one week before his death, anchored by an internal memo dated September 2, 2025 elevating Justin Streiff to COO and announcing a DOGE-style efficiency audit; (2) federal investigation conduct, anchored by direct testimonials from two rooftop-footage witnesses claiming the feds did not contact them until September 15; (3) technical engagement with viral Range Day Bro YouTube analysis, where the host partially debunks the blood-splatter claim (identifies it as Charlie's necklace chain) and partially corroborates the suspicious-bush claim using ground photographs. Side threads cover the Hamptons weekend narrative, a new doorbell-footage tip alleging Tyler Robinson changed clothes with an unidentified woman, and a defense of Erika Kirk against public criticism.

claims.label: Host Reads TPUSA Memo of September 2, 2025 Elevating Justin Streiff to COO and Announcing an Organization-Wide DOGE Effort
claims.claim: Per an internal TPUSA memo signed by Charlie Kirk on September 2, 2025 that the host reads, Justin Streiff was elevated to COO and empowered to engage in an organization-wide DOGE effort, assembling a small team to make TPUSA more efficient and cost-effective, unify it around company-wide metrics and goals, and reshape company culture.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original signed memo directly from TPUSA or insider sources; verify Streiff's actual scope of authority and the composition of the assembled team.
claims.transcript_snippet: In this role, I have empowered Justin… to engage in an organizationalwide Doge effort.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk expressed concern about TPUSA finances one week before his death
claims.claim: The host says that a week before his assassination Charlie Kirk expressed concerns about TPUSA finances and wanted to put together a little mini department to address those concerns, and that she has evidence of that.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify insiders, obtain contemporaneous communications, and confirm whether the DOGE team was actually stood up prior to September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: a week before Charlie lost his life, he expressed some concerns about the finances at Turning Point USA.
claims.uncertainty_note: Underlying insider testimony not directly presented in this episode; memo corroborates timing and organizational focus but not the exact motivation.

claims.label: Windows in the flag hall do not open, complicating the inside-source muzzle flash theory
claims.claim: The host says that, from everything she could see in the photos, the window in the flag hall does not open, so if the muzzle flash Range Day Bro describes came from inside, broken glass should be visible; she says she may be wrong and asks to be corrected.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain architectural plans or on-site verification of the flag hall windows' operability and check for any bullet or glass damage.
claims.transcript_snippet: those windows don't open. So if it's coming from inside… then we should see broken glass.
claims.uncertainty_note: Window-doesn't-open claim made by host based on photos; not independently verified.

claims.label: Range Day Bro's blood-splatter entry wound is actually Charlie's necklace chain

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain high-resolution frame-by-frame footage from multiple angles to confirm chain trajectory versus ballistic entry.
claims.transcript_snippet: that's actually not blood splatter. And I was very surprised by this. It's his necklace.

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the ground photographs referenced, compare with original Range Day Bro stills, and rule out alternative explanations (foliage, lighting).
